prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the ssurr, a hound-sized alien reptile with one enormous half-circle crest-fan. The fan is thin skin stretched over fine radiating rays and flushes with colour toward its rim; its edge carries fine comb-like tines (the dew-comb), so the rim is toothed and bristle-fringed. Closed, it is a straight blade; open, it is a wheel. Even-tempered, curious, tamable. Body: slim, long-limbed, hound-proportioned and lean. A long flat wedge-shaped head with a narrow snout, a heavy bony brow shelf and two forward-set pale eyes. Smooth skin of finely ridged, overlapping scale rows with a faint iridescent sheen. Long digitigrade legs with elongated three-toed feet, and a long whip-thin tail. The back is bare and smooth, and the fan is the only structure rising from it. The fan stands upright across the nape as one transverse half-circle wheel, in a plane at right angles to the spine, rising far above and beyond the head. It has one fixed orientation in every view. Side view (east): the fan is a tall, thin, edge-on blade rising from behind the head, its toothed rim a fine curved line, the slim body in profile beneath it. Front view (south, eyes toward the viewer): the fan is a full wheel rising behind and above the head, wider than the shoulders, with the same slim body and narrow snout seen head-on. Rear view (north, seen from behind): the fan's back face fills the upper body, with the haunches and tail below it and the eyes hidden. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour, clean dark outline. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
